题目.题目6:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干："A three-year plan" is a plan that lasts ______.
A. three months
B. three days
C. three years
D. thirty years
考点：用法
题目.题目7:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：In "a three-year-old", the hyphens join the words into one ______.
A. sentence
B. verb phrase
C. word
D. question
考点：用法
题目.答案:
【1】B（三岁）
讲解：three-year-old 三岁孩子。
【2】B（three-year-old）
讲解：作定语用 three-year-old。
【3】three years old
讲解：作表语不加连字符。
【4】three-years-old → three-year-old
讲解：定语里 year 不加 s。
【5】years
讲解：three 后面用复数 years。
【6】C（three years）
讲解：three-year 三年的。
【7】C（word）
讲解：连字符把几个词连成一个词。
